name: Beniarbeig (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Beniarbeig (a crowned shield with a tower, the Senyera and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Beniarbeig; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Beniarbeig arms — tower, Senyera and waves
